% Pattern: number/section. A command of the paper that writes \section with
% its argument and resets the equation counter numbers the sections. Seen in
% the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want thm-2 statement/theorem 2.1
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
\renewcommand{\theequation}{\thesection.\arabic{equation}}
\newcommand{\mysection}[1]{\section{#1}
\setcounter{equation}{0}}
\begin{document}
\mysection{One}
\begin{thm} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thm}
\mysection{Two}
\begin{thm} Every finite space is bounded. \end{thm}
\end{document}
